evidence: Tagged PSBT and modifies SignPSBTInput in src/psbt.cpp, which governs PSBT handling and signing in the wallet domain.
rationale: Fixes an interoperability bug where valid Taproot PSBTs fail to sign or finalize when PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE is absent. As noted in issue #36507 and BIP 371/341, 65-byte explicit sighash signatures were erroneously rejected with SIGHASH_MISMATCH, blocking valid multisig inputs.
